# routeros_interface_ethernet_switch_qos_map_vlan (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_interface_ethernet_switch_qos_map_vlan" "vlan" {
  comment  = "Managed by OpenTofu"
  dei_only = true
  disabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `dei_only` (Boolean) Match only frames that carry the Drop Eligible Indicator.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `map` (String) The internal traffic class the matched frames are mapped to.
- `pcp` (Number) The Priority Code Point of the received frame that this entry matches.
- `profile` (String) Name of the switch QoS profile this entry belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
